name: Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing and evals server)
category: self-hosted server (LLM observability, tracing and evaluation)
param_style: SQLAlchemy 2.0 async ORM/Core over aiosqlite + sqlean.py, compiled by the sqlite dialect; ? positional; IN lists expanded; the filter DSL compiles to SQL expressions at runtime
schema_source: Phoenix's own alembic migrations run by `phoenix serve` (arize-phoenix 21.0.0 from PyPI) against an empty SQLite file, dumped with .schema; only the tables the queries use (models in src/phoenix/db/models.py)
data_scale: scale 1: 24 projects; 49k traces (22k agent traces of 5 spans in one project, 3.7k sessions), 147k spans with JSON attributes, 51k span_costs + 102k cost details, 19k span / 1.3k trace / 12k document / 600 session annotations; 3 datasets (golden: 1000 examples, 3 versions), 26 experiments with 20k runs and 40k run evaluations; ~135 MB
visibility_note: 12k stars; widely self-hosted LLM tracing/eval server; SQLite (~/.phoenix/phoenix.db) is the default database
interest_note: Dashboard and table queries are heavy aggregates over string timestamps: percentile() over trace durations, hour-bucketed GROUP BYs, per-session token sums sorted for paging, a recursive descendants CTE seeded from a VALUES list, JSON_EXTRACT over span attributes, and experiment comparison aggregates with 21 SUM(CASE) columns over twice-computed per-run metrics.
reach_note: widely self-hosted; SQLite is the default storage for `phoenix serve` and the notebook launcher

cpu_evidence.summary: experiments page for a dataset that keeps gaining experiments: compareExperiments / experiment aggregates exceed a 60 s load-balancer timeout (v16.3.0) while CPU-bound in one query
ProjectPageHeaderQuery (costSummary, latency quantiles, trace count) fails on projects with >10k spans
Phoenix freezes and becomes slow under a high volume of incoming traces (span tables and header stats)
get_spans_dataframe for 20k spans returns 504 and makes the UI unresponsive while it runs
